name: HookRadar Self-Hosted Webhook Tester
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted webhook testing and debugging software with endpoint creation, real-time payload inspection, request replay/forwarding, custom responses, CSV export and SQLite request history; upstream advertises unlimited self-hosted usage without a software subscription or expiry.
watch_out: Requires your own Docker/Node.js hosting, storage, public HTTPS endpoint and access controls. Webhook payloads may contain secrets; protect workspaces and SQLite backups. The public shared Railway instance is a separate deployment and is not a guaranteed free hosting allowance; no free VPS, domain or network bandwidth included. Enterprise SSO/custom domains are planned, not included.
